But Faure's clone beats Tondelier by only 0.045 (vs 0.09-0.15 for others) and with 25% response jitter the Faure clone is sent to Tondelier in 1 of 20 runs. Mapping audit found no sign or scale error: UI buttons carry data-v = option.v (-2 'Pas du tout d'accord' ... +2 'Tout à fait d'accord', keys 1-5), answer() stores v unchanged, effective() uses it unchanged, scoreAll() uses |v - p| against position p as coded (+2 = strongly agree with the French wording). build.py copies position/confidence without transformation; 12x80 ids align with statements.json, core.json and questionnaire.json. Retest formula (orig - rev)/2 is correct for the five reversed items, which are genuine reversals. Gate imputations (eu1<=-1 -> eu6=-2; ret1>=1 -> ret2=-2; ene2>=1 -> ene1=-2, halved for |gate|=1, weight 0.5) are logically implied. One cosmetic issue: goBack() deletes the answer but does not undo applyGates() queue edits (ask_next items stay promoted; skipped items stay removed from the queue, though remainingStatements() re-adds them for the adaptive phase). This affects question order only, never scores.
